why: Names the product used to go by. A name that is gone must be gone from
everything a person can read -- and the one place it hides is the wordmark,
which is written across two elements (Trueline) and so is not a
contiguous string in any file. check-wordmark.py strips the markup first and
then looks, which is the only way to see it.

gone.name: Trueline
gone.why: The App Store name was taken by another construction measuring app.

allowed.why: The SwiftUI App struct. Not a name anybody reads; renaming it is a source change with no user-visible effect.
